reference: Studio Anne Emmanuel design brief pp.14–17,20–21

findings.finding: Patchy rug surface with overlapping backing and pile
findings.action: Separate rug surface from backing by at least 3 mm; test noncoplanarity

findings.finding: Mirror appears black; Reflector uses object rotation to compute normal
findings.action: Rotate reflector object, not merely mesh geometry; retain actual planar reflection, test direction

findings.finding: Orange tabletop and prominent procedural stripes differ from dark subdued walnut reference
findings.action: Darker base, lower grain amplitude, finer texture, subdued top sheen

findings.finding: Small light patches visible through chair backs; upholstered surfaces lighter than reference
findings.action: Reduce and move back pad inward; retain physical facing tests

findings.finding: Accent chair exterior ribbing too subtle and colour yellowish
findings.action: Increase low LOD rib depth and frequency, use darker olive

findings.finding: Hanging fixtures occlude overhead evidence; wall and connection camera composition insufficient
findings.action: Explicit sectioned overheads, revised wall and connection camera positions

findings.finding: Residual dark cabinetry adjacent to media unit, differs from reference
findings.action: Exact source identification and replacement still required; no unverified source suppression

findings.finding: Lighting uneven and some highlights overbright; fixture shape differs from photos
findings.action: Further visual lighting calibration and reference fidelity review required

findings.finding: Curtains and botanical relief not installed; geometry clearance constraint
findings.action: Do not block door/windows or restore removed wall; alternative approved location needed

findings.finding: Vase/books package not supported in previous console fit
findings.action: Search smaller scaled layouts with actual host clearance

findings.finding: Real planar reflection adds additional scene render per frame
findings.action: 120ms live reflection refresh interval; force reflection for explicit evidence; measure actual performance after build
